blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — Tribal leaders and elders of the Bukidnon-Daraghuyan Ancestral Domain (AD) vowed to keep their traditions alive and pass them to the next generation. They made the pledge as they celebrated Indigenous Peoples’ (IP) Month on Saturday, gathering to offer rituals and officially launch their new weaving hub, the “Balay Hu Paglala Ha Abaca” (House of Abaca Weaving). Bae Inatlawan Adelina Tarino, leader of the Bukidnon-Daraghuyan AD, highlighted the annual ritual’s significance in honoring nature spirits and elements essential to the tribe’s life and traditional livelihoods, underscoring their deep-seated reverence for nature and protection of ancestral lands.
